title: Institutional equity research — Microsoft
goal: Prepare a sourced, scenario-based institutional equity research report for Microsoft, including financial analysis, valuation, risks and deliverables.

context.summary: Initial request to analyze a listed company. No provider credentials or external write permissions are implied.

constraints.scope: Fundamental equity research; technical context only as supporting evidence.
constraints.source_policy: Prefer issuer filings and primary sources; identify data gaps and timestamps.

success_criteria: Issuer identity and reporting currency are verified.
Financial analysis and valuation assumptions are traceable.
At least bear, base and bull scenarios are presented where data permits.
Risks, limitations and data gaps are disclosed.
Requested deliverables are generated and checked, or unavailable formats are explicitly identified.

plan.summary: Identify issuer and sources, analyze financials, value the equity, review risks, prepare and quality-check deliverables.

tasks.title: Verify issuer identity and reporting basis

events.summary: Workflow created from the user's request.

checkpoint.next_action: Confirm issuer identity and reporting currency using authoritative sources.
